timezone.date_rule: 지연 여부는 서울 시간(Asia/Seoul)의 오늘 날짜보다 due_date가 앞선 미완료 task만 지연으로 계산

authentication.password_hashing: bcrypt handled by Supabase Auth; random salt per password
authentication.browser_secret_policy: Project URL + anon/publishable key only; service_role/secret key never shipped
authentication.session: Supabase JWT access token + refresh token
authentication.logout_invalidation: d2_current_session_is_active() checks JWT session_id against auth.sessions in Diary 2 RLS

d2_plan_versions.purpose: 계획 UPDATE 직전 OLD 값을 보존

security.rls: authenticated users only; every row must match auth.uid() = user_id and an active auth.sessions session
security.anonymous_access: revoked from all Diary 2 d2_* tables
security.legacy_migration: not included; Diary 2 is a new independent database
security.account_deletion: d2_delete_my_account() deletes auth.users row; owned d2_* rows cascade
security.secret_policy: service_role/secret key must never be shipped to browser

review_rules.delayed_count: 미완료이고 서울 시간 기준 오늘보다 due_date가 이전인 task 수
review_rules.blocked_count: blocked_reason이 하나라도 적힌 execution_log를 가진 task 수
